title: Progress of Initiative to Install Speed-management Devices on Lorries that Ferry Migrant Workers
what_it_is: Progress of Initiative to Install Speed-management Devices on Lorries that Ferry Migrant Workers

sections.label: Lorry speed limiter mandate
sections.summary: Government announced mandating speed limiters for lorries of 3,500 to 12,000 kilogrammes, with Traffic Police working with industry on implementation details to be announced later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In March 2022, we announced that the Government would mandate lorries with Maximum Laden Weight between 3,500 kilogrammes and 12,000 kilogrammes to be fitted with speed management devices or speed limiters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Traffic Police has since been working with industry stakeholders to evaluate the different types of speed limiter and to develop the implementation plan.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Industry stakeholders have given feedback that they would require some time to reconfigure their products to meet our requirements and conduct technical tests to ensure safety and roadworthiness.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The industry will also need time to ramp up the supply and to ensure that there are sufficient authorised agents to install these devices.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We aim to announce the details later this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: My supplementary question would be that I believe the earlier timeline that had been announced, if I am not wrong, was the first half of this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Given that there is a safety issue here at stake, would the Minister of State be able to commit to a timeline for the adoption of these speed limiters, going forward?

sections.label: Timely rollout assurance
sections.summary: Government is working with industry on costs, availability, effectiveness and installation, and will do its best in a timely manner.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: On our part, we are doing our best to work with them to make sure that what we do and finally roll out will have considerations with regard to the costs, availability, effectiveness and the installation process.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: I assure the Member that we will do our best in a timely manner.
